description: List videos. Each video has: id, title, status, created_at, length (seconds), folder_id, config. Results are returned newest first by default. There is NO server-side date filter or sorting — to find videos created on a specific date, fetch videos and check created_at in the response.

title.description: Search by video title (partial match, case-insensitive)
